verdict.rationale: Metorial documents uploading your own MCP server code for it to host and scale (metorial-docs-5, metorial-docs-23), and its catalog counts custom MCP servers among its integrations (metorial-gh-2). Discovery and connection by others is evidenced only inside an organization, through admin-approved portals (metorial-docs-9, metorial-docs-29), not through public distribution to outside users. Missing for 10: a documented publish-to-public-catalog or marketplace flow, discovery and installation of a custom server by external users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
